name: AI incidents & governance
summary: Parents sue Google over Gemini on school laptops; deepfake ads spread in US midterm campaigns
state: Parents in California sued Google, alleging its Gemini chatbot on school Chromebooks harmed a teenager, Just Security reported on 6 Nov. AI deepfake ads have grown more common in US midterm campaigns (Al Jazeera). No AI-enabled attack on critical infrastructure or AI-attributed mass harm had been reported as of 6 Nov.
for_you: Treat political video and audio shared online with caution, especially near elections. Parents may wish to review the AI tools enabled on school devices.
rubric_hit: Watch: significant AI misuse allegations and widespread election deepfakes; no AI attack on critical infrastructure

sources.title: Al Jazeera — AI deepfake ads grow more popular in US midterm campaigns

why: Powerful AI systems are being deployed faster than safeguards; serious incidents or governance breakdowns carry systemic risk.
drivers: Model releases, misuse incidents, regulation, compute controls, deepfakes in elections.

rubric.alert: AI-enabled attack on critical infrastructure, or AI-attributed mass harm event.
rubric.watch: A significant AI misuse incident, major deepfake disruption, or regulatory confrontation.
rubric.normal: No serious AI-attributed harm events or governance shocks this week.
